    input wire reset,
    input wire start,
    input wire [7:0] data_in,
    output reg mosi,
    output reg sclk,
    output reg cs,
    output reg done
);
    reg [2:0] bit_count;
    reg [7:0] shift_reg;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            mosi <= 0;
            sclk <= 0;
            cs <= 1; // Chip select inactive
            done <= 0;
            bit_count <= 0;

                bit_count <= 7; // Start with the most significant bit

                    sclk <= ~sclk; // Toggle clock
                    if (sclk) begin
                        mosi <= shift_reg[bit_count]; // Send bit
                        bit_count <= bit_count - 1; // Move to next bit
                    end
                end else begin
                    cs <= 1; // Deactivate chip select
                    done <= 1; // Transmission complete
                end
            end
        end
    end
endmodule

description: A simple Automatic Repeat reQuest (ARQ) protocol implementation that handles error detection and correction using a sliding window mechanism. The system will receive data packets, check for errors, and send an acknowledgment back to the sender. If an error is detected, it will request a retransmission of the corresponding packet.
code:
module ARQ_Controller(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input [7:0] data_in,
    input valid_in,
    output reg [7:0] data_out,
    output reg ack_out,
    output reg request_retransmit
);
    reg [1:0] state;
    parameter IDLE = 2'b00, RECEIVING = 2'b01, ERROR = 2'b10;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            ack_out <= 0;
            request_retransmit <= 0;
            data_out <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (valid_in) begin
                        data_out <= data_in; // Receive data
                        state <= RECEIVING;
                        ack_out <= 1; // Acknowledge receipt
                    end
                end
                RECEIVING: begin
                    if (data_in[7] == 1'b0) // Assume LSB indicates error
                        state <= IDLE; // No error, go back to IDLE
                    else
                        state <= ERROR; // Error detected
                end
                ERROR: begin
                    request_retransmit <= 1; // Request retransmission
                    if (valid_in) begin
                        state <= IDLE; // Go back to IDLE after retransmit request
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

        phase <= 2'b00;

        if (vco_count == 4'b1111) begin
            phase <= 2'b00; // aligned

            phase <= 2'b01; // clk_in faster
